rows.definition: internal/livecodebench's package-level const dateLayout = "2006-01-02", the Go time.Parse/Format reference layout string every LiveCodeBench contest_date, date-window bound, and normalized date field is parsed and re-rendered against.
rows.distinction: It is a Go stdlib TIME-FORMAT layout string (how a date is spelled as text) for the livecodebench package only, not a tensor/KV-cache memory layout (Layout tensor, mlaKVLayout, standardKVLayout) despite sharing the word 'layout'.
